title: Preparation of mitochondrial damage-associated molecular patterns from mouse liver tissue
protocol: Prepare Mitochondria Isolation Kit Reagents and PBS according to the materials and equipment section.
Wash each mouse liver in 20–40 mL PBS to remove excess blood and debris from tissue.
Swirl tissue in PBS using sterile tweezers or gently invert the tube with a cap to wash.
Cut liver tissue into smaller pieces (∼6–8 pieces of 50–200 mg) for easier Dounce homogenization.
Cut mouse liver into smaller pieces to facilitate Dounce homogenization.
Transfer liver pieces to Dounce homogenizer and add appropriate volume of Reagent A/BSA/protease inhibitor solution according to materials and equipment section.
Perform Dounce homogenization on ice.
Continue with Dounce homogenization until liver is completely dissociated and no visible pieces of intact liver tissue remain.
Discontinue once no visible pieces remain to avoid overprocessing.
Avoid excessive homogenization during liver tissue processing.
Transfer homogenized mixture of liver tissue and Reagent A/BSA/protease inhibitor solution to 2 mL microfuge tubes, adding 0.8 mL to each tube.
Add 0.8 mL Reagent C/protease inhibitor solution to each tube, cap, and invert gently to mix.
Centrifuge the mixture at 700 × g for 10 min at 4°C using a benchtop microcentrifuge pre-chilled to 4°C.
Remove supernatant carefully without disturbing pelleted material and transfer it to new 2 mL microfuge tube.
Discard pelleted material after centrifugation.
Centrifuge the supernatant again at 3,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C using a benchtop microcentrifuge.
Centrifuge the mitochondrial pellet at 3,000 × g.
Remove and discard the supernatant containing the cytosolic cell fraction.
Perform surface wash by adding 500 mL of Wash Buffer/protease inhibitor solution to the mitochondrial pellet without resuspending it.
Use a benchtop microcentrifuge to centrifuge the sample at 12,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend mitochondrial pellets in HBSS/protease inhibitor solution.
Combine resuspended mitochondrial pellets in a single conical tube.
Sonicate the mitochondria solution on ice at 100% amplitude for 30 seconds.
Rest for 30 seconds after each sonication pulse.
Repeat sonication and resting intervals for a total of 10 minutes.
Sonicate isolated mitochondria on ice.
Transfer the mitochondrial solution to tubes suitable for ultracentrifugation at 100,000 × g.
Weigh both sample and balance tubes and adaptors on a digital scale to ensure there is <1 mg difference in weight.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Carefully re-balance tube(s) before proceeding.
Centrifuge at 100,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant to isolate the mitoDAMP fraction.
Aliquot isolated mitoDAMP fraction into microfuge tubes if desired.
Store mitoDAMP preparation at -80°C until use.
